Recovery Girl's Errand.name: Recovery Girl's Errand
Recovery Girl's Errand.questStatement: Recovery Girl's infirmary is busy after every hard week of training, and she has drafted you to help: carry a supply delivery in from the Main Gate, sort it the way she likes, and sit with a patient who has been told to rest and keeps trying to leave. She hands out gummies and orders in equal measure, and if you ask the right questions, she will tell you what her healing can and cannot do.
Recovery Girl's Errand.mainObjective: Run Recovery Girl's errands, keep her patient in bed and hear from her what her healing costs and cannot do.

completionCondition.query: The PC has helped Recovery Girl with her errands and her resting patient, and at any point she has told the PC something her healing costs or cannot do (stamina, limbs, the dead, old damage, repeated breaks).

Recovery Girl's Errand.questDesignBrief: A warm, teaching quest. Recovery Girl is grandmotherly and blunt: her kiss speeds natural healing and spends the patient's stamina; she cannot regrow limbs, raise the dead or undo old damage, and bones broken again and again do not heal the same. The patient is whoever the story hurt most recently in training; if nobody, a Support Course student burned by a prototype in the Development Studio. She keeps every patient's records private and tells the PC nothing about another student's medical history. A teacher may drop in to be scolded. Failure: the patient slips out and gets worse, and Recovery Girl is disappointed in the PC. When the PC asks about her Quirk or her limits, she answers plainly in a line or two: her kiss speeds the body's own healing and spends the patient's stamina, and it cannot regrow limbs, raise the dead or undo old damage.
